notes: Topaz image and video enhancement mirror @ai-sdk/topaz 3.0.15: TOPAZ_API_KEY / X-API-Key authentication, custom base URL and headers, ai-sdk-topaz/3.0.15 user-agent, Wonder 3.5 image uploads or source URLs, validated enhancement options, cancellable polling and downloaded images; Proteus and Starlight Precise 2.6 video express requests, presigned uploads or remote sources, source/output/filter options, resumable V4 start/status operations, final credit estimates, output containers and structured errors. Image input is supported; masks and text-to-image are unsupported. API keys stay on the configured origin. Video generation uses AI.generateVideo or AI.startVideo/AI.getVideoStatus; unary video, video webhooks and a public video cancellation operation are absent upstream. Swift resolves credentials at factory creation and uses Data plus JSONValue options; JavaScript workflow serialization remains out of scope.
